name: 60140 · Hampshire, IL
findings: ZIP 60140 (Hampshire) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60140 (Hampshire) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
